audio.text: Who's giving the guest talk on Thursday?

options: On Thursday at four, in the main hall.
I gave my first talk in front of a big audience last semester.
Yes, I'm going with my roommate.
A journalist who covered the last Olympics, I think.

why.en: "Who" → a person. A gives a time and place; B repeats "talk" about something else; C answers "Yes" to a "who" question.
why.tr: "Who" → bir kişi. A saat ve yer veriyor; B "talk" kelimesini başka bir konu için tekrar ediyor; C "who" sorusuna "Yes" diyor.
why.es: "Who" → una persona. A da una hora y un lugar; B repite "talk" sobre otra cosa; C responde "Yes" a una pregunta con "who".
